title: GoHighLevel Automation & CRM Expert – Telehealth | Precise & Fast

facts: Post: You'll own HealFastRx's GoHighLevel marketing automation: funnels, workflows, landing pages, forms, email and SMS for patient acquisition, retention, product sales and feedback.
Post: You'll start by quality-checking our existing GoHighLevel flows, then connect them with new funnels.

Post: one feedback reply might trigger three other journeys and add a product-interest tag for later segmentation. You keep it all mapped and documented as it scales, and you learn and follow which patient data (PHI) must stay out of which systems.
Post: Email template design and testing, so every message renders cleanly in every inbox and on every device. A step-by-step approach to QA testing before anything goes live.
Personalization: no first name in the post; reviews say 'Healfast team' only, so the business name HealFastRx is used.
